Copies, unmodified, of the self-description examples of the ATIP contract at tag v1.1.1 (commit 16544ec22c022335eab4a0df17bf59e7508c67e8), identical at v1.1.2 (commit 3ab8b918d2aafaa5241e266a757b82fb75a1265a): `git diff v1.1.1 v1.1.2 -- examples schema scripts/regex-cases.json` is empty: `examples/schema-*.json` here and, of `examples/invalid/`, every `schema-*.json` in `invalid/`. (`schema-command-*` and the first ones of `invalid/` were first copied at v1.1.0, da69df042b1140915d6a5e674b306bf7b5cfd187; they are byte-identical at v1.1.1 unless git says otherwise.)
The `data` of a command document is the command document. Read by the unit tests of `src/l1/invocation.rs` and `src/l1/rules.rs` and by `tests/l1_examples.rs`, which judges every file with the same functions a run of `atip check --level L1` calls.
